newsitem.title: GREECE: GREEK BROKER YIANNOPOULOS ARRESTED FOR EMBEZZLEMENT.
newsitem.headline: GREEK BROKER YIANNOPOULOS ARRESTED FOR EMBEZZLEMENT.

text.p: Greek broker Adam Yiannopoulos was arrested late on Monday and charged for embezzlement of clients' funds totalling 1.5 billion drachmas, police said.
They said the arrest warrant cited embezzlement of funds which had been entrusted to Adam Yiannopoulos from bond and equity investors from his home city of Tripolis in the Peloponnese.
The warrant was issued by a special prosecutor based on a magistrates committee order, dated June 30.
Yiannopoulos, 45, is the main shareholder of one of Greece's smallest brokerages which carries his name and services retail clientele.
His firm ranked 62nd among Greece's 65 brokers, holding a 0.24 percent market share in 1996 with total turnover reaching 9.473 billion drachmas.
Yiannopoulos was arrested at his Sophocleus Street office, near the Athens bourse and was taken to Chalkis prison on Tuesday.
